summary: security checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; conditional for ordinary bounded growth; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or any security-sensitive launch. Evidence: the security baseline is read-only and explicitly not a penetration test or certification; fleet doctor has not run, with no deploy, uptime, error, authentication-boundary, secrets, container-isolation, dependency, incident, or disclosure-readiness evidence. TLS has no recorded certificates expiring within 30 days, but this is not proof of complete TLS coverage. Compliance reports 37 passes, 16 fails, and 6 unknowns across 59 sites. Exact decision: preserve only existing isolated, reversible work that adds no data collection, credentials, access surface, deployment scope, or monetization behavior; keep SearchWoot private and authorize no launch, outreach, credential, configuration, telemetry, spending, or production action.

Security review of ordinary fleet work: conditionally retain existing bounded SEO/content work only when execution remains isolated, preserves site boundaries, passes reviewer and smoke checks, records rollback, and introduces no new secrets, permissions, containers, dependencies, personal-data processing, analytics behavior, affiliate expansion, or public access path. Optional hardening alone is not a reason to block ordinary growth. Stop and escalate on any secret exposure, access-control regression, dependency or supply-chain concern, data leakage, incident signal, TLS failure, or disclosure-readiness issue.

SearchWoot security gate remains blocked. Available evidence does not establish authentication and access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency inventory or provenance, log and data exposure boundaries, incident response, or security.txt/disclosure readiness. The existing launch checklist correctly keeps the service private. Do not infer safety from absent findings or unavailable telemetry.

items.title: SearchWoot security launch gate disposition
items.summary: Maintain the private-preview gate because required security evidence is incomplete. This is read-only risk triage, not penetration testing or certification.
items.requested_action: Keep SearchWoot private. Before any public beta or security-sensitive release, obtain owner-approved evidence for authentication and access boundaries, secret exposure controls, container or runtime isolation, release and deploy controls, TLS coverage, dependency and supply-chain review, data exposure and log handling, incident signals and response, and disclosure readiness. No credentials, production changes, outreach, spending, or telemetry changes are authorized.
